title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to docs site; new example notebooks and templates in redwood-examples; docs landing updated with quickstart links.
commits: feat(rag): add base RAG agent template and configuration samples
docs(rag): add quickstart guide and step-by-step setup for tool-calling
examples: add tool-calling playbook notebook and minimal TS/Python snippets
chore: lint docs and fix codeblock formatting
test: add smoke tests for examples and CI notebook runner
description: Motivation: Users asked for concrete RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples to reduce time-to-first-success and to standardize best practices across the org. This PR adds a curated set of templates, step-by-step quickstarts for the docs site, and runnable examples in both Python and TypeScript so developers can copy/paste a working flow quickly. Summary: Adds an RAG agent template (basic_agent.yaml) and two example playbooks (tool-calling-playbook.ipynb and rag_tool_calling.py), updates docs site with a new quickstart page and TOC entries, and wires CI to run the examples smoke tests. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and examples - [x] Docs quickstart + TOC update - [x] Notebook + example smoke tests - [x] CI workflows for docs and examples - [x] Internal review and accessibility checks What changed (high-level): 1) docs/rag/agent-templates.md: new guide describing template fields, recommended settings for caching, batching and model fallbacks. 2) docs/quickstarts/rag-tool-calling.md: quickstart with prerequisites, minimal request/response examples, troubleshooting tips, and rollout recommendations. 3) redwood-examples: runnable notebook and language-specific snippets with environment setup and verification script. 4) CI: added docs-build and examples-smoke workflows to run the notebook runner and linting. Testing and CI: All checks passed on the final run. Docs build and link checker passed; Python unit tests and examples smoke tests passed in the matrix across 3 Python versions; TypeScript snippets compile and lint. Performance/regressions: No runtime-critical changes to serving runtime; examples exercise hosted API only. Security and privacy: Examples avoid real credentials and show KMS/HSM integration placeholders with guidance to use Redwood secrets manager in production. Rollout plan: Merge to main then backfill a cross-repo PR to add quickstart landing links in redwood-examples README. Related: ENG-3287 for templates work; PM-142 for docs prioritization. Merge: Squash-merged after approvals. Notes for reviewers: Please verify that the quickstart language matches SDK changes in the linked SDK PRs and that examples are runnable on CI images.
conversation: Luca Moretti (reviewer): Can we add a short section on caching implications for prefix-heavy RAG workloads? Priya: Added a dedicated paragraph in docs/rag/agent-templates.md explaining prefix cache sizing and eviction policy recommendations.

Aisha Patel (reviewer): Notebook runs on CI were flaky on first run due to a timing issue with the example server. Priya: Added explicit readiness check and retry with exponential backoff in examples-smoke.yml and notebook preamble.
Daniel Kim (approver): Docs look good; please squash and add release notes. Priya: Release notes added and CI green, ready to merge.
